name: Yunipare! ~Unit of Palette~
source:
～ Who do you dream with? ~
This is an art university. You are the idol group "Yunipare! As a producer, let's have a fun school life with unique friends!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/593]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
～你和谁一起做梦？～
